reported_finding: Same macOS Unified Log traceID values appear across different host records and were interpreted as reused activity identifiers.

project_semantics.fact: UnifiedLogCallsite.trace_id encodes static format-string offset, message type and flags; the callsite docstring explicitly distinguishes a tracepoint ID from an occurrence ID. Repeated calls at one point retain the same native trace ID.

finding: False positive: the same built-in callsite in the same executable image is expected to reuse the tracepoint identifier across hosts and occurrences. The value is not an activity identifier, so this does not create cross-host activity correlation.
decision: No code change. Keep reviewer score unchanged; exclude this item from actionable defect priorities.
